serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: That Annalie…{{wi}} She was really giving us a hard time, wasn’t she?
You: I guess it just highlights how much this fashion show matters to her. 
Bot: You’re right. We need to give our all too. It’s because of us she decided to debut earlier than she wanted.
You: I’m trying to help, but I don’t know how much strength I have left… 
Bot: Let’s get cozy at home and get some rest then! 
You: Sure, we deserve it.
